description: Two dancers walk round each other with one shoulder toward the other.

walkthrough.line: Walk round {who} with your {hand} shoulder toward them, looking at each other, {amount}.
walkthrough.teach: Walk forward round {who} with your {hand} shoulder toward them, turning your body as you go so the two of you are looking at each other the whole way round. That is what tells a shoulder round from a do-si-do. Your hands stay at your sides. Go {amount}.

walkthrough.line: Half a shoulder round with {who}, {hand} shoulders, eyes on each other the whole way.
